children: shares fell 2% on Tuesday even after the drugmaker introduced a new brand identity and updated its corporate culture, as an analyst said the changes may need to be supported by a broader strategy.
BMO Capital analyst Evan Seigerman kept a Hold rating and a $47 price target on the shares. That target implies about 8% upside from current levels.
The company began using the name Novo in its branding and introduced The Novo Way, a culture centered on patients and consumers. Its legal corporate name remains Novo Nordisk A/S.

Seigerman viewed the rollout of the Wegovy pill as a positive development but said the company still needs to show how it can maintain growth over the next decade. He also pointed to pressure from Eli Lilly in diabetes and obesity treatments as a concern.

title: Novo Nordisk Stock Falls After Major Rebrand
